title: 2권 2유닛 스토리북 · 3쪽
prompt: Flat vector illustration in the style of a modern children's English textbook: simple geometric shapes, bold flat solid colors, at most one flat darker shadow tone per object, clean smooth edges with no outlines or only very thin dark outlines, rounded friendly forms, no texture, no gradients, no watercolor, no paper grain, no photo-realism, no 3D render. Bright cheerful palette (red, orange, yellow, green, blue, sky blue). Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks anywhere in the image. Full illustrated scene: the background is made of a few large flat color shapes (ground, bushes, sky) with a calm plain sky area near the top, characters large and clearly visible. No text, no letters. Do NOT draw any speech bubbles, thought bubbles or empty white balloons of any kind. Letter trees are ordinary round leafy trees with small fruits (like an orchard); never shape trees, clouds, paths or any object like letters of the alphabet. Full-page picture-book illustration. Use the attached character sheet ONLY to copy how the characters look. Draw ONLY these characters: Bun, Hedgie, Grumble. Every other character on the sheet must NOT appear in this picture. Scene: The red backpack drifts to the reeds; a brown dog swims behind pushing it with its nose, tail wagging; a paper tag and an old rag hang from the strap. In the reeds Grumble has hooked the strap with his lantern pole and lifts the bag out — and now wears Bun's blue cap on top of his nightcap, grumpy but pleased; Bun laughs and points; Hedgie hugs his wet bag on the stones. Hidden in the picture: the bag, the rag, the wagging dog, the tag. Characters: Bun is a small white rabbit standing on two legs, one long ear flopped down, green rain boots, brave smile. Hedgie is a small hedgehog standing on two legs, soft spikes with one tiny flower stuck in them, curious cautious eyes. Grumble is a grumpy old raccoon standing on two legs, dark eye mask, a striped nightcap, holding a tiny candle lantern in one paw, frowning sleepily, slippers.
